newsitem.title: UK: BFI down 16 points to 1,488, Panamaxes weaken.
newsitem.headline: BFI down 16 points to 1,488, Panamaxes weaken.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down 16 points to 1,488 on Tuesday, primarily due to weaker rates for Panamaxes, brokers said.
Having stayed above 1,500 since mid-November, weaker Panamax rates from the U.S. Gulf continued to pressure the market.
Brokers said Hanjin fixed 54,000 heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Japan for 6/18-12 at $23 no combination, down $1.10 from Goldbeam's fixture on Monday yesterday of Bright Field.

Dreyfus was rumoured to have booked a Panamax on subjects for U.S. Gulf/Continent at between $13.50 and $14.00 basis 55 feet. Another sharply lower fixture was believed to have been booked by Continental for a 1981 built Panamax delivery U.S. Gulf in November with a trip via the Continent at $9,000 daily plus 140,000 bonus.
Elsewhere, Panamaxs and Caper rates remained generally steady. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8075
